::: {#exm-activation-function}

#### The logistic function as an activation function

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
pre = first(x_test[0])
print(pre[:4].detach().numpy().round(3))
print(torch.sigmoid(pre[:4]).detach().numpy().round(3))
```

In @exm-hidden-layer the [activation function](#def-activation-function) is the [logistic function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-logistic-function),
$g(z) = \sigmoidf{z} = 1 / \paren{1 + \e{-z}}$.
The first line printed holds the first 4 entries of $\matr{W}_1 \vx + \vecf{b}_1$ for the first test image,
and the second holds the logistic function of each.
The logistic function maps each entry separately:
entry 1 of the output depends only on entry 1 of the input.

:::
